trade.services.title: Services trade
trade.services.summary: Georgia’s annual services trade, in nominal US dollars.
trade.services.emptySelection: Select service types to compare their trends. The ranking stays visible below.
trade.services.sourceNote: Source: Geostat · annual services trade · nominal USD
trade.services.definitions: Services exports are supplied by Georgian residents to non-residents; imports are received by Georgian residents from non-residents. Missing observations remain gaps or dashes. Publication status: unspecified.
trade.services.bulkScope: Clear and Select all apply to the services total and all twelve service types, regardless of search.
trade.services.shareNote: Shares use the corresponding national services total for the same year and measure.
trade.services.balanceRankingNote: Ranked by the size of the services balance, regardless of sign. Negative values mean services imports exceed exports.
trade.services.balanceNote: Services balance = services exports − services imports. A positive amount means services exports exceed imports; a negative amount means services imports exceed exports.
trade.services.balanceAria: Annual services balance in USD, showing positive and negative values around zero
trade.services.workbookNote: Total services trade = services exports + services imports; services balance = services exports − services imports. Missing amounts remain blank. Publication status: unspecified.
trade.domestic.title: Domestic exports
trade.domestic.summary: Explore domestic goods exports and compare them with total exports and re-exports in nominal US dollars.
trade.domestic.emptySelection: Select indicators to compare. The end-year figures remain below.
trade.domestic.definitions: Domestic exports include goods originating in Georgia and imported goods substantially processed here; they do not measure domestic value added. Re-exports are calculated as total exports minus domestic exports using reviewed matching records. All values are goods exports in nominal USD, on an FOB basis.
trade.domestic.countryDefinitions: Export countries are final destinations. Re-exports use only reviewed matching total and domestic-export records. An unsupported historical country match remains unavailable. Amounts are shown in whole US dollars, so an amount under half a dollar shows as 0. Shares use the corresponding Georgia total for the same year and measure.
trade.domestic.productDefinitions: The source publishes a selected list of domestic-export products plus Other commodities. Omitted products are not zero, and the remainder is not allocated to individual products. This view shows domestic exports only; no product re-export amount is inferred. Shares use Georgia’s domestic-export total for the same year.
trade.domestic.countryBulkScope: Clear and Select all apply to Georgia total and every country, regardless of search.
trade.domestic.workbookNote: Re-exports = total exports − domestic exports, using reviewed matching records. Domestic exports do not measure domestic value added. Missing amounts remain blank. Publication status: unspecified.
trade.title: Trade overview
trade.summary: Compare Georgia’s annual exports, imports, total trade and trade balance in nominal US dollars. Goods only.
trade.metaDescription: Explore Georgia’s annual goods exports, imports, total trade and trade balance in USD.
trade.emptySelection: Select one or more indicators to compare. The end-year figures and balance chart remain below.
trade.sourceNote: Source: Geostat · annual goods trade · nominal USD
trade.balanceNote: Trade balance = exports − imports. A negative value means imports exceed exports; a positive value means exports exceed imports. Exports use FOB valuation; imports use CIF.
trade.balanceAria: Annual trade balance in USD, showing positive and negative values around zero
trade.workbook.formulas: Total trade = exports + imports; trade balance = exports − imports. Publication status: unspecified.
trade.partners.title: Trading partners
trade.partners.summary: Compare annual goods trade with individual countries and country groups in nominal US dollars.
trade.partners.bulkScope: Clear and Select all apply to every country and group.
trade.partners.emptySelection: Select countries or groups to compare their trends. The ranking stays visible below.
trade.partners.groupOverlap: Country groups overlap. Their values and shares must not be added together or added to individual countries.
trade.partners.definitions: Export partners are final destinations; import partners are sending countries, which may differ from manufacturing origins. Exports include re-exports.
trade.partners.shareNote: Shares use Georgia’s national total for the same year and measure. Country groups overlap.
trade.partners.balanceRankingNote: Ranked by the size of the balance, regardless of sign. Negative values mean imports exceed exports.
trade.partners.unavailable: No value published for this year
trade.partners.noRanking: No numerical values are available for the chosen year and measure.
trade.products.title: Products
trade.products.historicalNote: Historical product versions are separate and are not joined across source periods.
trade.products.workbookNote: Missing amounts stay blank; published numerical zero stays zero. All selected series are included.
trade.products.search: Search by name, code or keyword…
trade.products.bulkScope: All products, including Georgia total. Search and categories do not limit Clear or Select all.
trade.products.noMatches: No products match this search. Try another name or four-digit code.
trade.products.emptySelected: No products selected. Browse categories or search to add a product.
trade.products.unavailable: A dash means no value for the selected year.
trade.products.summary: Compare annual goods exports and imports by product in nominal US dollars.
trade.products.emptySelection: Add products to start a comparison. The leading products remain below.
trade.products.selectionReset: This saved product selection is unavailable or outdated. Georgia total has been restored; add products to start a new comparison.
trade.products.shareNote: Shares use Georgia’s national total for the same year and trade flow.
trade.products.definitions: Exports include re-exports and use FOB values; imports use CIF values. Missing observations remain gaps or dashes. Publication status: unspecified.
trade.composition.title: Trade composition
trade.composition.summary: Compare Georgia's goods exports and imports by broad product groups and economic categories.
trade.composition.searchCategories: Search categories by name or code
trade.composition.emptySelection: Select categories to compare their trends. The ranking stays visible below.
trade.composition.bulkScope: Clear and Select all apply to Georgia total and every category in this view, regardless of search.
trade.composition.shareNote: Shares use Georgia’s national total for the same year and trade flow.
trade.composition.sourceNote: Source: Geostat · annual goods trade by SITC and BEC · nominal USD
trade.composition.definitions: Goods groups follow SITC sections; economic categories follow BEC. Capital goods includes the stated parts and accessories; transport equipment is separate. Exports include re-exports and use FOB values; imports use CIF values. Missing observations remain gaps or dashes.
trade.composition.workbookNote: Nominal USD. Exports include re-exports (FOB); imports use CIF values. Missing amounts remain blank.
trade.services.countryBulkScope: Clear and Select all apply to Georgia total, all countries and the published other/unknown entries, regardless of search.
trade.services.countryEmptySelection: Select countries to compare their trends. The ranking stays visible below.
trade.services.countryDefinitions: Country values use Geostat’s published country totals. Other countries, international organizations and undefined/unknown entries remain separate; the ranking lists named countries only. Total trade and balance require both exports and imports for the same country and year. Missing values stay blank.
